d:
Chhotanagpur ki 'rani' kahe jane vale netarhat ki thandi vadiyon aur mithi nashpati se to har koee vakiph hai, lekin ab is saphar ka svad aur romanch doguna hone vala hai. netarhat ki rasili nashpati ka svad chakhne ke bad, paryatak ab raste men hi gumla ki taji chay ki chuski ka aanand le sakenge.
